answer: Pair identities at random for a live exchange that must happen in the same short window: two strangers trade questions and answers in real time, and the exchange spirals outward from a starting point neither could predict. One operator steering a nebula of copies cannot be present in many conversations at once, and mirrored replies give them away. A crystal record of who met whom, and when, turns presence itself into the scarce resource — copies fade because one mind cannot attend everywhere at once.
